note: Invented names and descriptions for the items the stub campaign and the tests use, keyed by internal item name. Compiled by pnpm stubs into binarydata/itemdesc.edt (name 80, short name 80, description 240 units per item index; other rows stay empty). Original writing for ja2-node.

GLOCK_17: A compact 9mm sidearm with a polymer frame. Light, dependable and easy to feed.
GLOCK_18: The service pistol's louder cousin, able to empty a magazine in a heartbeat.
COMBAT_KNIFE: A heavy blade for rope, ration tins and the occasional emergency.
CREATURE_YOUNG_MALE_CLAWS: Hooked claws as long as a man's hand.
CREATURE_OLD_MALE_CLAWS: Thick, scarred claws from a creature that has survived a long time.
CREATURE_YOUNG_FEMALE_CLAWS: Narrow, fast claws built for slashing.
CREATURE_OLD_FEMALE_CLAWS: Heavy claws from an old and dangerous creature.
CREATURE_QUEEN_TENTACLES: Whipping limbs that can reach across a cavern.
ROCKET_LAUNCHER: A single-shot disposable launcher. Point it away from friends.
CREATURE_OLD_MALE_SPIT: A thick stream of corrosive fluid.
CLIP9_15: A standard box magazine of fifteen 9mm rounds.
CLIP9_30: An extended magazine that sticks out of the grip like a ruler.
KEVLAR_VEST: Layers of woven fibre that stop pistol rounds and slow down the rest.
LEATHER_JACKET_W_KEVLAR: A worn leather jacket with armour panels sewn into the lining.
FIRSTAIDKIT: Bandages, tape and antiseptic. Enough to stop the bleeding.
TOOLKIT: Wrenches, pliers and screwdrivers rolled up in canvas.
CANTEEN: A dented metal canteen. A long drink restores some energy.
JAR: A glass jar with a screw lid.
LETTER: An envelope closed with wax. It is not addressed to you.
WINE: A local red with a hand-written label.
BEER: Warm, but it is still beer.
VIDEO_CAMERA: A shoulder camera with a cracked viewfinder.
SILVER: A small pouch of old silver coins.
GOLD: A nugget the size of a thumbnail.
